states.basis: No chapter in the provided list covers general contractors or construction trades licensing; Chapter 61 articles focus on health professions, architects, engineers, and other specific occupations, but not construction trades.
CHAPTER 9 - Contractors in Division 3 is the primary licensing statute for general contractors and construction trades in California.

Minnesota Statutes Chapters 214–215 (Examining and Licensing Boards) contain the state licensing framework for general contractors and construction trades; specific contractor licensing statutes are housed within this part.
Chapter 4740 'Construction Industry Licensing Board' is the umbrella container for construction trades licensing; specific sub-articles for general contractors are not listed separately.
Chapter 11 - Contractors is the dedicated licensing chapter for general contractors and construction trades in Virginia.
